facts.fact: le360 cites data from the 2024 General Population and Housing Census (RGPH 2024) showing about 1.73 million Moroccans, 4.8% of the population, live with a disability.

A joint study by the Mediator institution, the ONDH and the Secretariat of State for Social Inclusion, presented in March 2026, found only 47.5% of public institutions offer inclusive digital solutions and 25% of administrations are inclusive overall.
